DATA:
The image depicts a horizontal double-headed arrow containing three terms representing a spectrum of virtue/vice:
- Left side: Cowardice
- Center/Right-of-center: Courage
- Right side: Foolhardiness

KEY FACTS:
- Shows a horizontal continuum/spectrum bounded by arrows on both ends.
- Contains three labeled points: "Cowardice" on the far left, "Courage" toward the middle, and "Foolhardiness" on the right.
- Represents the Aristotelian golden mean concept, placing the virtue (Courage) between two extreme vices (Cowardice and Foolhardiness).
